steps.content: The apparition is standing right under the red moon, not so far away from you. It looks nothing like any other apparition you've encountered.
The apparition doesn't turn around, nor does it answer your question. You see the red moonlight slowly encroaching on its body. Suddenly, you hear a monstrous roar.
The gray filth on the ground has gathered to form a mud monster. It is now gliding quickly toward you.
